name: Mam ca loc Thoi Binh
summary: Mắm cá lóc Thới Bình is fermented snakehead from Thới Bình, north of Cà Mau city. It is a collective trademark and a gift to carry home.
origin: Thới Bình. Vietnam Airlines lists it as a gift, and Nhân Dân lists it as a collective trademark. Grilled U Minh snakehead is a different plate.
where: Thới Bình, and the Cà Mau city shops that sell gifts.
